articles.summary: Let us begin by congratulating everyone, for we all have made it through a whole year amidst a global pandemic! The year has been a rollercoaster ride with its share of ups, down, twists and turns, but it’s come to a pleasant halt. It was yet another year of spreading high-fives through our little pops of joy. Our Roas
articles.title: Don’t Know About You But We’re Feeling (20)22!
